landing.title: What to hold. While you hold it. When to rebalance.
landing.lede: A worksheet for someone investing from Bangkok. Three numbers produce a mix you can actually buy — SET funds, Thai bank funds, and US ETFs — and the desk keeps score until the mix drifts.
landing.sampleNote: Illustrative mix for ฿1,000,000 at a middle risk score. Yours updates as you move the sliders.
landing.step1Body: Years, an amount in baht or dollars, and a target return that maps to a risk profile. Monthly savings, a Thai or global tilt, and ThaiESG or RMF are optional.
landing.step2Body: Asset weights come from a glide path blended with an inverse-volatility tilt. Each sleeve is split into a fund code or ticker, with units, a fee where we have one, and how to reach it from Thailand.
landing.step3Body: Price jumps, allocation drift, and a shift in news tone each produce a suggested action: hold, rebalance a baht amount, or swap a satellite into the core fund.
landing.inputsBody: Timeline, amount, risk. Everything else has a sensible default.

disclaimer.short: Educational worksheet. Not licensed advice under Thai securities law, and not a recommendation to buy or sell any fund, ETF, or share.

plan.title: Build the book
plan.lede: The mix updates as you move the inputs. Nothing is saved until you ask.
plan.monthlyHelp: Used only in the projection. The instrument list is the lump sum.
plan.fanNote: Each line is a percentile of 280 simulated paths. The mix is reset every month. Contributions are added at month end. This is not a forecast.
plan.stepsNote: Calculation notes stay in English in this version.
plan.instrumentsNote: Baht and dollar amounts are the instruction. Unit counts for unlisted funds use a reference NAV, not today's official NAV. SET lines are rounded to a board lot of 100. Leftover cash sits in K-CASH.
plan.accept: I understand this is an educational worksheet, not licensed financial advice.

desk.title: The desk
desk.chartReplay: This line replays today's units on past prices. It is not an account history. Your own track record starts on the day you saved.
desk.chartHeld: Units have been held since {date}. The index starts at 100 on that day.
desk.benchmark: Benchmark: 40% SET50 ETF, 40% S&P 500, 20% Thai bonds, held constant.
desk.driftNote: The mark is the target. The bar is the market value today.
desk.emptyBody: Build a mix from your timeline, amount, and risk. The desk fills in once you save it.
desk.seedNote: Prices on this desk started as a saved tape so the charts are populated offline. Refresh replaces listed names with Yahoo Finance.
